content:
While iOS 27 is already the new focus of pre-installed software, Apple is still preparing iOS 26.6 as the next iPhone update. Apple has released the first release candidate (RC) of iOS 26.6. iOS 26.6 beta has been in testing since late May.

iOS 26.6 Features and Changes

So far, we have discovered two notable changes in the iOS 26.6 beta.

First, there is a change to the upper limit on the number of contacts that can be blocked. Second, it appears a brand-new iPhone anti-theft feature is in development.

This update may also prepare Spotlight indexing on iPhone and iPad for use by Siri AI in iOS 27. Today's RC release notes publicly confirm this for the first time.

Not many more new features or changes are expected, as all focus has now shifted to iOS 27.

Apple's next major software update will roll out to users in September, with iOS 27 continuing to be iterated on throughout the summer.

iOS 26.6 will be the next version released, building on iOS 26 which launched last fall and its subsequent updates.

Last year, iOS 18.6 beta 1 came out after iOS 26 beta 1. In other words, iOS 26.6 is slightly ahead compared to Apple's 2025 release schedule.
